related.description: Self-hosted music streaming server 🎶 with RESTful API and Web interface. Think of it as your very own Spotify! ☁️🎧
Open Source & Self-hosted Spotify release tracker. Auto-syncs new releases to playlists and includes power-user utilities like a discography...
Swing Music is a beautiful, self-hosted music player for your local audio files. Like a cooler Spotify ... but bring your own music.
